mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.login_name AS loginName, a.email_masked AS emailMasked, a.email_vault_token AS emailVaultToken, (a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.owner_status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.security_status = 'ACTIVE') AS active FROM t_user_account a LEFT JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_type = 'INTERNAL' AND t.owner_ref_id = 1 LEFT JOIN t_tenant_member m ON m.account_id = a.account_id AND m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE a.realm = 'OPERATIONS' AND a.account_type = 'HUMAN' AND a.account_id IN #{id}
SELECT account_id AS accountId, login_name AS loginName, email_masked AS emailMasked FROM t_user_account WHERE realm = 'OPERATIONS' AND account_id IN #{id} ORDER BY account_id
